captures.description: THE LIBRARY, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'The Internet Archive is a non-profit digital library founded in 1996 by Brewster Kahle and headquartered in San Francisco, California.' What it offers (the Wayback Machine, 'over 1 trillion web captures'; the free digital library; Open Library, 'allowing users to borrow digitized physical books like a traditional library'; Save Page Now); key details ('Status: 501(c)(3) non-profit organization'; preservation work; 'users on Reddit generally note that it honors DMCA takedown requests and site-exclusion preferences like `robots.txt`'); a follow-up offer. Eight cards: archive.org, Wikipedia, Facebook, a YouTube video by the Internet Archive, Reddit, the Chrome Web Store, the Library of Congress, a Facebook video by the Internet Archive.
